items.evidence: Total Revenue | Is a leading indicator of performance and value creation; provides a clear focus on growth
Adjusted Diluted EPS | Is a measure of income; provides focus on profitable growth
Cash Flow from Operations | Provides focus on generating cash in the short-term to fund operations and research
a qualitative assessment of Pfizer's performance with respect to the product pipeline;
business performance as compared to goals in other areas, as well as the management of the impact of LOEs
Operating Income | Operating income, as the PSA performance measure, is based on Pfizer's Non-GAAP Adjusted Operating Income
relative TSR as compared to the DRG Index, over a #-year period
Absolute TSR | Provides direct alignment with shareholders as awards are tied to absolute TSR
